description: Make a level or a param of a score move over time: a part's gain or pan, a send's level, or any device param (a nested one by its path: filter.cutoff_hz, bands[0].gain_db), as points {at_beats, value} with a curve to the next point (hold, linear or smooth). Replaces that param's points between from_beats and until_beats; an empty list clears them. Returns the new score_id (edit that one next).

from_beats.description: Start of the range replaced. Default 0

curve.description: The move from this point to the next

until_beats.description: End of the range replaced. Default the score's end

name: score.set_automation

beats.description: Beats from the start (a quarter note is 1)

frames.description: At the score fps, exact (45.5 is half way through frame 45); absent without fps
